nodes.label: Step 0: Confirm the migration scope
nodes.rationale: Scope phrases like 'my project' are ambiguous; ask before any edit to avoid touching unintended files

nodes.label: Step 1: Classify each file (caller / definer / opaque string / suffixed variant)
nodes.rationale: Not every file containing a model ID calls the API; definers keep old entries because old models are still served

nodes.label: Capability gate: add new ID alongside
nodes.rationale: Replacing would silently disable features for old-model traffic

nodes.label: Explain every change you make
nodes.rationale: Prompt edits are judgment calls; distinguish optional [TUNE] edits from required 400-avoiding edits

nodes.label: [BLOCKS] / [TUNE] checklist tagging
nodes.rationale: BLOCKS items cause 400s/truncation and must be code edits; TUNE items are recommendations

nodes.label: Manual extended thinking (budget_tokens)
nodes.rationale: Deprecated on 4.6, 400 on Opus 4.7+ and newer models

nodes.label: Effort parameter (output_config.effort)
nodes.rationale: No 1:1 mapping from budget_tokens; controls thinking and acting

nodes.label: refusal stop reason handling
nodes.rationale: Classifier declines are HTTP 200; check stop_reason before reading content[0]

nodes.label: Server-side fallbacks parameter
nodes.rationale: Preferred refusal recovery; 'default' routes by refusal category

Preserved thinking (model + conversation binding)

nodes.label: Append-only history pattern
nodes.rationale: Keeps prompt cache warm and thinking blocks valid

nodes.label: Coverage-first code-review prompt
nodes.rationale: Newer models follow severity filters literally, depressing measured recall

nodes.label: Over-verification: delete verification scaffolding
nodes.rationale: Opus 5 self-verifies; verification instructions cause redundant work
